noun_definition: Chat refers to the messaging feature within the app where users can insert emojis by typing specific codes, such as ':eye', to enhance their communication.

Emoji suggestion refers to the feature in the app that displays a list of emoji options when a user types a colon followed by the emoji name, which should automatically close upon inserting the selected emoji.

Eye emoji refers to the specific emoji represented by the code ':eye:' that users attempt to insert into the chat application, which is expected to automatically close the emoji suggestion menu upon insertion, similar to other emojis like ':heart:' and ':joy:'.
